note_manual: Printed inconsistencies visible in the crops (details in the digest §3-9 / §11): (1) Fig. 4 caption and text: '(a) RT, (b) 100°C, and (b) 150°C' — '(b)' twice, and the figure has no panel letters; (2) text p.3 'thickness … from approximately 104 µm to 94 µm' vs the plotted markers 102.97 → 97.46 → 94.74 µm [read from the vector plot]; (3) the same nominal condition (600 MPa, 100 °C, 60 s) has void ratio 0.0419 in Fig. 3 and 0.0287 in Fig. 8 while the thickness marker is identical (97.46 µm) in both plots; (4) the Mn band of Fig. 7(a) (RT) is at least 121 µm high and that of Fig. 7(b) (190 °C) about 102 µm [read], against 103 µm (RT) in Fig. 3; (5) Conclusions: 'implying a correction with the void ratio' (correlation); (6) p.2 'SEM images shown blow'; 'secondary electron microscopy (SEM)'; (7) the 190 °C sample appears only in Fig. 6 / Fig. 7 (no void ratio, thickness or cell data); (8) p.2 'working electrode … with and without WIP treatment' but no cell data of the untreated electrode are shown; (9) abstract / p.1 formula typeset as 'Li(Ni1/3Mn1/3Co1/3)O2' with an unsubscripted 'Co1/3' in the abstract; (10) 'void ratio' here = (void + carbon voxels) / all voxels — not the soil-mechanics void ratio e = Vv/Vs.
key_note: manual keys: f<N><letter> = printed panel of Fig. N (panel_of); f5ac = equivalent-circuit inset of Fig. 5(a) (label '5a-circuit'); x<PDF page><letter> = evidence paragraph (kind 'text').  'page' and all 'bbox' values = PDF page / PDF points; printed page = S1166 + PDF page (S1167–S1173).  'bbox' = ink bounding box + 6 pt margin (3 pt for the circuit inset); 'auto_bbox' = the tool's original box for the two re-cut figures.  'dpi' of an entry = render resolution of that PNG (300 = tool default for raster figures and text; 400 = vector plots and figures with small vector lettering; 900 = circuit inset); 'native_dpi' / 'src_native' = resolution / pixel size of the embedded raster.  x7a is a two-part crop (references + received line) — 'parts' lists both boxes.

digitized.method: numpy + Pillow + PyMuPDF only (script kept outside the repo).  Fig. 3 and Fig. 8 are vector plots: marker centres and the plot frame were taken from the PDF drawing objects (no pixel reading; frame = axis limits, ticks counted).  Fig. 2 / Fig. 9: nearest-colour classification of the categorised images in the native rasters (green AM / red SE / black voids + carbon), scale-bar label masked — single displayed 2-D slices.  Fig. 4: curve pixels by colour in the native raster, axes on the plot frame (check: CV plateau 3.681–3.683 V, cut-off 2.483 V vs printed 3.68 / 2.48 V).  Fig. 5(a)/(b): column centroids of the coloured dots, axes on frame / ticks.  Fig. 6: grey-level thresholds at the histogram valleys + blob analysis (rough).  Fig. 7: row profile of Mn-count pixels.  Everything read from figures is tagged [판독] in the digest; printed values are tagged [인쇄].
